text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The holiday season is upon us once again. It comes and goes faster than a runner in the Satsuki Sho…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Argh! Who ever suggested that I should come through the chimney? It's narrow beyond belief!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ugh, my bag's all caught up. This calls for a bit of pushing to make things right!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ack, I've ripped it! But at least it's loose!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hyuck hyuck, indeed I am! Now, hand over yer gold!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: …Hold up. It's the holidays, right? No point in hiding it now…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'm Mati-santa Fuku-claus! I'm here to give presents to all the good boys and girls!
choice_data_list: I'm sorry. Can you say your name again?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oof! Please, could I not? It's not like I didn't say it right the first time…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: A-anyway, I have a present for you. Put your hand in the bag and pull out whatever you like.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'm giving out presents, fortune-slip style! I'll give you whatever you pull out, all right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I put my hand in and grab the first thing I touch…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Let's take a look… Great fortune! Congratulations! Pulling great fortune is a gift in itself!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you not happy? Guess I'll have to make this right. Here, take this!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ta-dah! Inside the box is a festive tree that's a thousand years old! A plastic replica of it, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It's a good prize. Go on, open it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I unwrap my present and open the box…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Wait, nooo! The star at the top of the treeeee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The star has snapped right off. It probably broke when she snagged it inside the chimney.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, I can only apologize… What sort of Mati-santa am I…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer. Could you come outside with me for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! Can I get some glue and tape, please?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Just give me a moment—I'll fix this right up. Uuugh, this is so embarrassing…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I really wanted today's celebrations to be a little more holy-feeling. This is so pathetic…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Sniff… You're so kind!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: While you're being so kind, could I ask you for another favor? When we get back, could you help me stick the star back on?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It can wait until after we've eaten our holiday cake, though. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite the tribulations, we have fun trying to mend the tree together. Strangely enough, it's turned out to be a pretty heartwarming holiday.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Okay, plan B! Time to pull out my secret weapon! Come on, Trainer, lift the tree high up into the sky!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Doesn't it look like there's a real star on top of it now? How romantic is that!
choice_data_list: I want to have a proper star on top.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ack! My little illusion wasn't good enough for you? I thought I really turned on the charm there…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I guess I'd better use the star that fell off, huh? Sigh…
choice_data_list: Why don't you use the star that you'll win at the Arima Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huh? The Arima Kinen? That's still coming… up…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ah, I see what you did there! That was actually pretty cool. Seems I'm no match for you.
choice_data_list: Promise me you'll get that star?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer… Y-yeah, I'll do it. By the way…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: You're dressed to impress today, huh? My heart is racing just looking at you…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: My face is so red, I'm about to become Matikane-feelin'-the-heat-now. Wait, we're right in the middle of winter. Did I just flub another joke?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We still don't have the star we need for the tree. It's time to go and win it for ourselves.
